# Vocabulary infrastructure/v0

Infrastructure as code and deployment plans: resources, data sources, modules and resource groups, with planned actions. Defined in docs/models/infrastructure-model.md. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/vocabularies/infrastructure/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/vocabularies/infrastructure/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/vocabularies/infrastructure/v0.json).

An extraction follows this vocabulary when its `vocabularies` include it; its `schema` must be `architecture/v0`. The extraction schema applies this one to it.

## Typed data

The engine checks every typed field, and reports a violation at its path. Other `data` fields are open JSON.

### Entities

| Kind | Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Every kind | `data.type` | string |  | The ecosystem's resource type. |
| Every kind | `data.provider` | string |  | Terraform's provider source address, or ARM's resource provider namespace. |
| Every kind | `data.action` | string |  | The planned action: `create`, `update`, `replace`, `delete`, `read`, `import`, `forget` or `deploy`; absent when nothing happens. |
| Every kind | `data.replaceOrder` | string |  | `destroy-before-create` or `create-before-destroy`. |
